extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in about:addons and the AMO listing.

welcomeHeading.message: One quick step before you start
welcomeHeading.description: Main heading on the welcome page.

welcomeIntro.message: Firefox blocks every extension from creating private windows by default. You need to allow it once for Open in Private Window.
welcomeIntro.description: Intro paragraph on the welcome page.

welcomeStep1Title.description: Title of step 1 on the welcome page.

welcomeStep1GoTo.description: Text before the about:addons address and Copy button on the welcome page.

welcomeCopyButton.description: Label of the button that copies 'about:addons' to the clipboard.

welcomeCopyFeedbackSuccess.description: Feedback shown after successfully copying the address.

welcomeCopyFeedbackError.message: Could not copy - please select and copy manually.
welcomeCopyFeedbackError.description: Feedback shown if the clipboard write fails.

welcomeStep1Instructions.message: Click "Extensions" in the left sidebar, then click on "Open in Private Window".
welcomeStep1Instructions.description: Second paragraph of step 1 on the welcome page.

welcomeStep2Title.description: Title of step 2 on the welcome page.

welcomeStep2Body.message: Find "Run in Private Windows" and set it to Allow.
welcomeStep2Body.description: Body of step 2 on the welcome page.

welcomeStep3Title.description: Title of step 3 on the welcome page.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Right-click any tab and choose "Open in Private Window".
welcomeStep3Body.description: Body of step 3 on the welcome page.

welcomeNote.message: "Open in Private Window" opens a new private window with the same address — Firefox does not support private "tabs" inside a normal window. Your original tab stays open and unaffected.
welcomeNote.description: Closing note on the welcome page.

optionsPageTitle.description: <title> and main heading of the options page.

optionsCloseTabTitle.description: Title of the 'close original tab' setting.

optionsCloseTabBody.message: After opening the private window, close the tab you right-clicked on. Off by default.
optionsCloseTabBody.description: Description of the 'close original tab' setting.

optionsCleanParamsTitle.description: Title of the 'clean tracking parameters' setting.

optionsCleanParamsBody.message: Strip known tracking query parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, and similar) from the URL before opening it. Off by default.
optionsCleanParamsBody.description: Description of the 'clean tracking parameters' setting.

optionsSavedIndicator.description: Brief confirmation shown after a setting is changed.
